# Vendored assets

## `github-markdown.css`

- Source: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/github-markdown-css@5.8.1/github-markdown-light.css>
- Package: [`github-markdown-css`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/github-markdown-css) v5.8.1
- License: MIT (Copyright Sindre Sorhus and GitHub contributors)
- Purpose: make the local preview render with the same typography and spacing as
  GitHub's README view. The preview is still generated by GitHub's Markdown API;
  this stylesheet only supplies the presentation layer.

The file is unmodified. It is committed so `make preview` and
`make screenshots` work without a build step.
